boundary_rules.rule: Only a Supabase-bound operational Card may support a RESOLVED operational authority claim. Repo/Drive presence alone is insufficient.
A GitHub Card pack without explicit current Supabase operational binding remains a technical/candidate artifact; it cannot be silently upgraded to S31-C RESOLVED.
NO_DIRECT_CARD is a valid governed outcome when no Card is required/applicable; it must not trigger manual work solely because no direct Card exists.
More than one materially applicable Card without deterministic precedence is AMBIGUOUS and fail-closed.
S31-C resolves applicability/fallback semantics; it does not create, update, promote or mutate Cards or their carriers.
Card lifecycle authoring remains upstream of S31-C. S31-C consumes the resulting authority/currentness binding, never substitutes for CREACION_CARD_LF or ACTUALIZACION_CARD_LF.
Typed Context must carry reconstructible authority source refs/digests and card_resolution status. Schema invention remains forbidden.
Runtime execution is downstream. It may validate supplied Card materialization but may not decide AUTHORITY, CURRENTNESS, CARD_APPLICABILITY, PROMOTION, GOLDEN or PRODUCTION.
A same-request Card materialization receipt must bind operational card ref, version/revision or digest, selected content/sections, budget and provenance before model use when a Card is required.
S31 candidate vocabulary is adapter-bound. Existing S26 boundary vocabularies remain valid until governed cutover; no big-bang migration.

s31_candidate_adoption_policy.reason: S31 contracts remain candidate and independent-review/promotion gates are not closed.
